narr: A very moist airmass led to the development of thunderstorms with heavy rainfall rates during the morning and afternoon of June 4th. Significant flash flooding occurred in and around the city of Marshfield. Additional heavy rainfall caused flooding into the evening and overnight hours with some areas picking up two day totals of 3-5 inches.
ev: Route H in was closed due to flooding in Camden County.
Significant street flooding occurred in the city of Marshfield with numerous road closures in and around the city.
A water rescue occurred along Mill Dam road south of Northview.
The Cumberland road bridge was not passable due to flooding.
The Pisgah road bridge was not passable due to flooding.
Two water rescues occurred along the Pomme De Terre River at Cologna Road and Greenwood Road just north of Interstate 44. Water was several feet deep over the road.
Tavern Creek was flooded over Hwy U outside of Crocker.
The bridge over the Niangua River at State Highway Y was washed out near Black Horse Rd. The road was closed.
State Highway W was closed due to flooding along Givins Branch.
Route J was closed due to flooding.
Route H was closed due to flooding of Rocky Creek.
Route NN was closed due to flooding of Rocky Creek.
